# Constants
```{r constants}
name <- "TabulaMuris_Liver"

COUNTS_FILE <- here("Filtered_Input", "TabulaMuris_Liver_Counts.csv")
LABELS_FILE <- here("Filtered_Input", "TabulaMuris_Liver_Labels.csv")

CSV_DIR  <- here("Data_Hold", "VST_Tabula_Muris")  # output CSVs
PLOT_DIR <- here("Vst_TabulaMuris_Liver")          # output plots
for (d in c(CSV_DIR, PLOT_DIR)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Plot appearance
FONT_FAMILY     <- "Arial"
BASE_SIZE       <- 10
PLOT_DPI        <- 300
PLOT_WIDTH      <- 5   # inches (1500 x 1200 px at 300 dpi)
PLOT_HEIGHT     <- 4
LEGEND_POSITION <- c(1, 0)  # bottom-left, inside the panel

COL_PG    <- "#1BB7D8"
COL_HVG   <- "#E55B1E"
COL_UNION <- "#2C9F45"

X_LABEL      <- "Cumulative GPS (%)"
Y_LABEL_SENS <- "Clustering Sensitivity"
Y_LABEL_ARI  <- "Adjusted Rand Index"

# Violin plots
VIOLIN_N       <- 9
VIOLIN_NCOL    <- 3
VIOLIN_PT_SIZE <- 0
```

# Helpers
```{r helpers}
# Save a plot as both LZW TIFF and JPEG (file_stub = path without extension)
save_plot_both <- function(plot, file_stub, width = PLOT_WIDTH, height = PLOT_HEIGHT) {
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stub, ".tif"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "tiff", compression = "lzw", type = "cairo", bg = "white")
  ggsave(filename = paste0(file_stub, ".jpg"), plot = plot, dpi = PLOT_DPI,
         width = width, height = height, units = "in",
         device = "jpeg", quality = 100, type = "cairo", bg = "white")
}

# PG / HVG / Union metric vs threshold, with gene-count labels.
# cols = c(PG column, HVG column, Union column) in points_df
make_metric_plot <- function(points_df, cols, y_label) {
  plot_df <- points_df %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cols), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")
  plot_df$metric <- factor(plot_df$metric, levels = cols)

  plot_df$label_val <- NA
  is_pg    <- plot_df$metric == cols[1]
  is_union <- plot_df$metric == cols[3]
  plot_df$label_val[is_pg]    <- plot_df$num_genes[is_pg]
  plot_df$label_val[is_union] <- plot_df$union_num_genes[is_union]

  ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = thresholds, y = value, color = metric)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    # PG labels
    geom_text(
      data = plot_df[is_pg, ],
      aes(label = label_val),
      color = COL_PG, vjust = +2, size = 3, family = FONT_FAMILY,
      check_overlap = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # Union labels
    geom_text(
      data = plot_df[is_union, ],
      aes(label = label_val),
      color = "darkgreen", vjust = -2, size = 3, family = FONT_FAMILY,
      check_overlap = TRUE, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_smooth(
      method = "loess", formula = y ~ x,
      method.args = list(span = 1, degree = 1, surface = "direct"),
      se = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = X_LABEL, y = y_label, title = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(
      breaks = cols,
      values = setNames(c(COL_PG, COL_HVG, COL_UNION), cols),
      labels = setNames(c("Principal Genes", "Seurat's HVG", "HVG_PG_Union"), cols)
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = BASE_SIZE, base_family = FONT_FAMILY) +
    theme(
      legend.position             = "inside",
      legend.position.inside      = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.justification.inside = LEGEND_POSITION,
      legend.box.margin           = margin(4, 4, 4, 4),
      legend.title                = element_blank(),
      legend.background           = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), colour = NA)
    )
}

# Violin plot of the first VIOLIN_N genes of a set; Seurat stores "_" as "-"
make_violin <- function(seurat_obj, genes, file_suffix) {
  features <- gsub("_", "-", head(genes, VIOLIN_N))
  features <- features[features %in% rownames(seurat_obj)]
  if (!length(features)) {
    message(file_suffix, ": no genes to plot; skipped")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  p <- VlnPlot(seurat_obj, features = features, ncol = VIOLIN_NCOL, pt.size = VIOLIN_PT_SIZE) &
    theme(text            = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY),
          axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x     = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y    = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none")
  print(p)
  save_plot_both(p, file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0(name, "_", file_suffix)))
}
```

# TABULA_MURIS_LIVER

## Load data and true labels
```{r load-data}
count_matrix <- read.csv(COUNTS_FILE, check.names = FALSE, row.names = 1)
colnames(count_matrix) <- gsub("\\.", "-", colnames(count_matrix))

full_true_labels <- read.csv(LABELS_FILE, check.names = FALSE)
full_true_labels$cell <- gsub("\\.", "-", full_true_labels$cell)

# One label per count-matrix column, in column order (all clustering uses count_matrix)
cells <- colnames(count_matrix)
idx   <- match(cells, full_true_labels$cell)
if (anyNA(idx)) stop(sum(is.na(idx)), " cells in the count matrix have no label in ", LABELS_FILE)

label_levels <- unique(full_true_labels$label[full_true_labels$cell %in% cells])
true_labels_vector <- setNames(
  as.numeric(factor(full_true_labels$label[idx], levels = label_levels)),
  cells
)
k_cls <- max(true_labels_vector)
message(length(true_labels_vector), " cells, ", k_cls, " true clusters")
```

## Get principal genes
```{r principal-genes}
set.seed(12345)
principal_genes_results <- principalgenes(count_matrix, cut = 1, filters=c("riboFilter", "mtFilter", "gmFilter", "rikFilter"))
filtered_counts<-principal_genes_results$count_matrix
top_100_genes<-names(principal_genes_results$top_genes[1:50])
```

## SK_MEANS CLUSTERING USING CUMULATIVE SCORE
```{r skmeans-pg}
thresholds <- seq(10, 50, by = 2)

selectedGeneList <- list()
current_gene_list <- list()
currentpropsum <- 0
threshold_index <- 1

for(i in seq_along(principal_genes_results$top_genes)){
  
  current_gene_list <- append(current_gene_list, principal_genes_results$top_genes[i])
  
  currentpropsum <- currentpropsum + principal_genes_results$top_genes[i] * 100
  
  if(currentpropsum >= thresholds[threshold_index]){
    selectedGeneList[[threshold_index]] <- current_gene_list
    
    print(paste("Threshold", thresholds[threshold_index], "reached at index", i))
    
    threshold_index <- threshold_index + 1
    
    if(threshold_index > length(thresholds)){
      break
    }
  }
}

num_genes <- list()
for (i in seq_along(selectedGeneList)){
  num_genes[[i]]<-length(selectedGeneList[[i]])
}
num_genes<-unlist(num_genes)

sumprop<- 0
for (i in seq_along(principal_genes_results$top_genes)){
  sumprop <- sumprop + principal_genes_results$top_genes[i]*100
}

PG_groups_sk <- list()
PG_clustering_sk <- list()
PG_results_sk <-list()
PG_clustering_sens_sk<-list()
seeds<-c(12345, 54672, 44182, 72198, 98230)

for (i in 1:length(seeds)){
  print(paste("seed:", seeds[i]))
  for (j in 1:length(selectedGeneList)){
    set.seed(seeds[i])
    submat<-count_matrix[names(selectedGeneList[[j]]),]
    PG_groups_sk[[j]]<-skmeans(x = t(log2(submat + 1)) , k = k_cls, control = list(verbose = FALSE))$cluster
    print(paste0(j, "th clustering done"))
  }
  PG_clustering_sk[[i]]<-PG_groups_sk
}

for (i in 1:length(PG_clustering_sk)){
  print(paste("seed:", i))
  for (j in 1:length(selectedGeneList)){
    PG_results_sk[[j]] <- clustSensitivity(PG_clustering_sk[[i]][[j]], true_labels_vector, as.character(1:k_cls))
    print(paste("got clustering results:", j))
  }
  PG_clustering_sens_sk[[i]]<-PG_results_sk
}
```

## SK_MEANS CLUSTERING USING HVGS
```{r skmeans-hvg}
set.seed(12345)
seuratObject<- CreateSeuratObject(counts = as.matrix(count_matrix))
norm_seuratObject <- NormalizeData(seuratObject)
seuratObject<- FindVariableFeatures(norm_seuratObject, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = length(principal_genes_results$top_genes)) #variance stabilized used as the metric here. some regression stuff is done that you need to look into.
HVGs <- VariableFeatures(seuratObject) #Vector of descending order HVGs

positions<-match(HVGs, seuratObject[["RNA"]]@meta.data$var.features)

scored_hvg<- seuratObject[["RNA"]]@meta.data$vf_vst_counts_variance.standardized[positions]
names(scored_hvg) <- HVGs
scored_hvg[is.na(scored_hvg)] <- 0
scored_hvg <- sort(decreasing = TRUE, scored_hvg)

commongenes<-intersect(names(principal_genes_results$top_genes), names(scored_hvg))

# SKmeans clustering
HVG_groups_sk <- list()
HVG_clustering_sk <- list()
HVG_results_sk <- list()
HVG_clustering_sens_sk <- list()

for(i in 1:length(seeds)){
  print(paste("seed:", seeds[i]))
  for(j in seq_along(num_genes)){
    set.seed(seeds[i])
    submat<-count_matrix[HVGs[1:min(length(HVGs),as.numeric(num_genes[j]))], ]
    HVG_groups_sk[[j]]<-skmeans(x = t(log2(submat + 1)) , k = k_cls, control = list(verbose = FALSE))$cluster
    print(paste0(j, "th clustering done"))
  }
  HVG_clustering_sk[[i]]<-HVG_groups_sk
}

for (i in 1:length(seeds)){
  for (j in seq_along(num_genes)){
    HVG_results_sk[[j]] <- clustSensitivity(HVG_clustering_sk[[i]][[j]], true_labels_vector, as.character(1:k_cls))
  }
  HVG_clustering_sens_sk[[i]]<-HVG_results_sk
}
```

## SK MEANS CLUSTERING USING UNION OF HVGS AND Principal Genes AT EACH POINT
```{r skmeans-union}
pg_hvg_union<-list()

for(i in seq_along(selectedGeneList)){
  pg_hvg_union[[i]]<-unique(union(names(selectedGeneList[[i]]), HVGs[1:length(selectedGeneList[[i]])]))
}

Union_groups_sk <- list()
Union_clustering_sk<-list()
Union_results_sk <-list()
Union_clustering_sens_sk<-list()

for(i in 1:length(seeds)){
  print(paste("seed:", seeds[i]))
  for(j in 1:length(selectedGeneList)){
    set.seed(seeds[i])
    submat<-count_matrix[pg_hvg_union[[j]],]
    Union_groups_sk[[j]]<-skmeans(x = t(log2(submat + 1)) , k = k_cls, control = list(verbose = FALSE))$cluster
    print(paste0(j, "th clustering done"))
  }
  Union_clustering_sk[[i]]<-Union_groups_sk
}

for(i in 1:length(seeds)){
  for (j in 1:length(selectedGeneList)){
    Union_results_sk[[j]] <- clustSensitivity(Union_clustering_sk[[i]][[j]], true_labels_vector, as.character(1:k_cls))
  }
  Union_clustering_sens_sk[[i]]<-Union_results_sk
}
```

## PLOT CLUSTERING RESULTS COMPARING HVGS AND CUMULATIVE SCORE
```{r plot-results}
RowNames <- list()
pg_points_sk <- list()
hvg_points_sk <- list()
union_points_sk<-list()

for(i in 1: length(num_genes)){
  sens_sum=0
  for(j in 1:length(PG_clustering_sens_sk)){
    sens_sum = sens_sum + as.numeric(PG_clustering_sens_sk[[j]][[i]][1,2])
  }
  pg_points_sk[[i]] <- sens_sum/as.numeric(length(PG_clustering_sens_sk))
  RowNames[[i]] <- i
}

for(i in 1: length(num_genes)){
  sens_sum=0
  for(j in 1:length(HVG_clustering_sens_sk)){
    sens_sum = sens_sum + as.numeric(HVG_clustering_sens_sk[[j]][[i]][1,2])
  }
  hvg_points_sk[[i]] <- sens_sum/as.numeric(length(HVG_clustering_sens_sk))
}

for(i in 1: length(num_genes)){
  sens_sum=0
  for(j in 1:length(Union_clustering_sens_sk)){
    sens_sum = sens_sum + as.numeric(Union_clustering_sens_sk[[j]][[i]][1,2])
  }
  union_points_sk[[i]] <- sens_sum/as.numeric(length(Union_clustering_sens_sk))
}

sens_points <- data.frame(
  row.names = unlist(RowNames),
  PG_sensitivity=as.numeric(unlist(pg_points_sk)),
  HVG_sensitivity = as.numeric(unlist(hvg_points_sk)),
  PG_HVG_Union = as.numeric(unlist(union_points_sk)),
  thresholds =as.numeric(thresholds),
  num_genes = as.integer(num_genes),
  union_num_genes = as.integer(sapply(pg_hvg_union, length))
)
write.csv(sens_points, file.path(CSV_DIR, paste0(name, "_SKM_accuracy_results.csv")))

sens_plot <- make_metric_plot(sens_points,
                              c("PG_sensitivity", "HVG_sensitivity", "PG_HVG_Union"),
                              Y_LABEL_SENS)
print(sens_plot)
save_plot_both(sens_plot, file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0(name, "_PG_HVG_UNION_Sensitivity")))

#adjustedRandIndex
pg_rand <- list()
hvg_rand <- list()
union_rand <- list()
for(i in 1:length(num_genes)){
  rand_sum_pg = 0; rand_sum_hvg = 0; rand_sum_union = 0
  for(j in 1:length(seeds)){
    rand_sum_pg    <- rand_sum_pg    + adjustedRandIndex(PG_clustering_sk[[j]][[i]],    true_labels_vector)
    rand_sum_hvg   <- rand_sum_hvg   + adjustedRandIndex(HVG_clustering_sk[[j]][[i]],   true_labels_vector)
    rand_sum_union <- rand_sum_union + adjustedRandIndex(Union_clustering_sk[[j]][[i]], true_labels_vector)
  }
  pg_rand[[i]]    <- rand_sum_pg    / length(seeds)
  hvg_rand[[i]]   <- rand_sum_hvg   / length(seeds)
  union_rand[[i]] <- rand_sum_union / length(seeds)
}

rand_points <- data.frame(
  row.names = unlist(RowNames),
  PG_randIndex=as.numeric(unlist(pg_rand)),
  HVG_randIndex = as.numeric(unlist(hvg_rand)),
  PG_HVG_UnionRand = as.numeric(unlist(union_rand)),
  thresholds =as.numeric(thresholds),
  num_genes = as.integer(num_genes),
  union_num_genes = as.integer(sapply(pg_hvg_union, length))
)
write.csv(rand_points, file.path(CSV_DIR, paste0(name, "_SKM_rand_index_results.csv")))

rand_plot <- make_metric_plot(rand_points,
                              c("PG_randIndex", "HVG_randIndex", "PG_HVG_UnionRand"),
                              Y_LABEL_ARI)
print(rand_plot)
save_plot_both(rand_plot, file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0(name, "_PG_HVG_UNION_RandIndex")))
```

## PRINCIPAL GENES AND HVGS COMPARISON
```{r pg-hvg-comparison}
#Common genes between TOP 100 Principal Genes results and Highly Variable Genes
common_gene_names<- intersect(names(principal_genes_results$top_genes[1:100]), names(scored_hvg[1:100]))
pg_only_gene_names <- setdiff(names(principal_genes_results$top_genes[1:100]), common_gene_names)
hvg_only_gene_names <-setdiff(names(scored_hvg[1:100]), common_gene_names)

#Ranks of Principal Genes based on scores
pps_ranks <- rank(-as.numeric(principal_genes_results$top_genes))
names(pps_ranks) <- names(principal_genes_results$top_genes)

#Ranks of HVGs based on scaled dispersion score
hvg_ranks <- rank(-as.numeric(scored_hvg))
names(hvg_ranks) <- names(scored_hvg)

#Variance of each gene
variance_values <- apply(count_matrix, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
variance_values <- sort(decreasing = TRUE, variance_values)

#Mean expression of each gene
mean_values <- apply(count_matrix, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_values <- sort(decreasing = TRUE, mean_values)

#Compare the ranks of intersecting genes
intersect_df <- data.frame(
  PPS_rank = pps_ranks[common_gene_names],
  HVG_rank = hvg_ranks[common_gene_names],
  Variance = round(variance_values[common_gene_names], 4),
  Mean = round(mean_values[common_gene_names], 4)
)

#Compare the scores of the top100 Principal Genes to their rank in the top 100 HVGs and their mean and variance scores
raw_scores_df <- data.frame(
  PPS_score_percent = principal_genes_results$top_genes[1:100]*100,
  HVG_rank = hvg_ranks[names(principal_genes_results$top_genes[1:100])],
  Variance = round(variance_values[names(principal_genes_results$top_genes[1:100])], 4),
  Mean = round(mean_values[names(principal_genes_results$top_genes[1:100])], 4)
)

write.csv(intersect_df,  file.path(CSV_DIR, paste0(name, "_PPS_HVG_Variance_Mean_Intersect.csv")))
write.csv(raw_scores_df, file.path(CSV_DIR, paste0(name, "_PPS_HVG_Variance_Mean_Top100.csv")))
```

  PG_Only_Violin_Plot           = pg_only_gene_names,
  HVG_Only_Violin_Plot          = hvg_only_gene_names,
  PG_HVG_INTERSECT_Violin_Plot  = common_gene_names
